Name: Achaicus
Summary: Achaicus was one of the Corinthian brethren who came to Paul and supplied what was lacking from the church, refreshing Paul's spirit.
KeyStory: Achaicus was one of the Corinthian brethren who came to Paul and supplied what was lacking from the church, refreshing Paul's spirit.
LifeLesson: Coming in person can supply what letters cannot.
